BEGIN

    DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{

  ]
}';

    DECLARE @action INT;
    SET @action = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.clientContactPreferences')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        [clientContactPreferenceId] INT NULL,
        [companyId] INT NULL,
        [clientId] INT NULL,
        [channel] NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        [marketingOptIn] BIT NULL,
        [source] NVARCHAR(30) NULL,
        [optedInAt] DATETIME NULL,
        [optedOutAt] DATETIME NULL,
        [updatedByUserId] INT NULL,
        [active] BIT NULL
    );

    BEGIN TRY
        INSERT INTO @payload ([clientContactPreferenceId], [companyId], [clientId], [channel], [marketingOptIn], [source], [optedInAt], [optedOutAt], [updatedByUserId], [active])
        SELECT [clientContactPreferenceId], [companyId], [clientId], [channel], [marketingOptIn], [source], [optedInAt], [optedOutAt], [updatedByUserId], [active]
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.clientContactPreferences')
        WITH (
        [clientContactPreferenceId] INT '$.clientContactPreferenceId',
        [companyId] INT '$.companyId',
        [clientId] INT '$.clientId',
        [channel] NVARCHAR(20) '$.channel',
        [marketingOptIn] BIT '$.marketingOptIn',
        [source] NVARCHAR(30) '$.source',
        [optedInAt] DATETIME '$.optedInAt',
        [optedOutAt] DATETIME '$.optedOutAt',
        [updatedByUserId] INT '$.updatedByUserId',
        [active] BIT '$.active'
        );

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        IF @action = 1
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[clientContactPreferences] ([companyId], [clientId], [channel], [marketingOptIn], [source], [optedInAt], [optedOutAt], [updatedByUserId], [active], [created_At])
            SELECT p.[companyId], p.[clientId], p.[channel], p.[marketingOptIn], p.[source], p.[optedInAt], p.[optedOutAt], p.[updatedByUserId], ISNULL(p.[active], 1), GETDATE()
            FROM @payload AS p;

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].value', CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS VARCHAR(20)));
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted Successfully');
        END
        ELSE IF @action = 2
        BEGIN
            UPDATE t
            SET
                t.[clientId] = ISNULL(p.[clientId], t.[clientId]),
                t.[channel] = ISNULL(p.[channel], t.[channel]),
                t.[marketingOptIn] = ISNULL(p.[marketingOptIn], t.[marketingOptIn]),
                t.[source] = ISNULL(p.[source], t.[source]),
                t.[optedInAt] = p.[optedInAt],
                t.[optedOutAt] = p.[optedOutAt],
                t.[updatedByUserId] = p.[updatedByUserId],
                t.[active] = ISNULL(p.[active], t.[active]),
                t.[updated_at] = GETDATE()
            FROM [dbo].[clientContactPreferences] AS t
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p ON t.[clientContactPreferenceId] = p.[clientContactPreferenceId] AND t.[companyId] = p.[companyId];

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Updated Successfully');
        END
        ELSE IF @action = 3
        BEGIN
            DELETE t
            FROM [dbo].[clientContactPreferences] AS t
            INNER JOIN @payload AS p ON t.[clientContactPreferenceId] = p.[clientContactPreferenceId] AND t.[companyId] = p.[companyId];

            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Deleted Successfully');
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Invalid action');
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
        SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    END CATCH

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage, '$.result');
END
